Vaccine Effectiveness, Burden and Impact Studies (VEBIS) of COVID-19 and Influenza – Tender Specifications ECDC/2021/12924 
DL 1.3.8. Weekly 
validation of datasets; 
datasets and production 
of weekly 
epidemiological data 
summary/report/ 
bulletin.  
Collection (as needed) and validation of dataset. This is foreseen as a regular 
and constant activity through the course of the project. 
Deliverable includes scripts, datasets and epidemiological data summary. 
Format to be agreed during monthly teleconferences.  
The validation of the datasets will be performed in close collaboration with the 
countries/study sites and will be aimed to build capacity and foster a 
progressive improvement of data reported by the countries/study sites over 
the course of the framework contract. Communication between the contractor 
and the countries/sites to validate the data will take place using principles 
agreed between the contractor and ECDC and periodically revisited. 
On a weekly basis 
 
Word; Excel, csv, html

Collection (as needed) and validation of dataset. This is foreseen as a regular 
and constant activity through the course of the project. 
Deliverables includes scripts, datasets and epidemiological data summary. 
Format to be agreed during monthly teleconferences; cumulative data 
presented since the beginning of data collection. The format of the 
epidemiological data summary will be agreed with ECDC. 
The validation of the datasets will be performed in close collaboration with the 
countries/study sites and will be aimed to build capacity and foster a progressive 
improvement of data reported by the countries/sites over the course of the 
project. Communication between the contractor and the countries/sites to 
validate the data will take place using principles agreed between the contractor 
and ECDC and periodically revisited.  
On a monthly basis
